simple.summary: יָעָה (yâʻâh) means to brush aside First listed occurrence: Isa 28 17.

definitions.full: H3261. yaah יָעָה verb sweep together (with collateral idea of carrying away ) (Arabic is collect, gather ) — Qal Perfect וְיָעָה consecutive Isa 28:17 subject בָּרָד with accusative ( ב ׳ויעה כָזָב מַחְסֵה ). **Compare also Arabic vessel Gen 42:25 Saad, compare Baldensperger PEF 1904, 53, who compares Modern Arabic wa±â ().
